purpose: Closed, versioned predicate vocabulary for deterministic SAFOR transition guards. Arbitrary executable expressions are forbidden.

predicates.description: Every dependency of the subject work item is ACCEPTED.
At least one active unrevoked Control-State mandate covers the subject work item and every required capability.
All subject work-item input refs resolve to value-stream objects with a non-null artifactRef.
The subject work item contains a schema-complete execution.resourceAccess declaration with readSet, writeSet and exclusiveKeys arrays.
A resolved state/event field equals the provided literal value.
A resolved state/event field is a member of the provided literal set.
The event type equals the provided value.
The event sequence is exactly lastAppliedEventSequence + 1.
The event subject resolves to exactly one work item.
No ACTIVE Acceptance Contract is already registered for the subject work item.
The event Acceptance Contract hash, subject, approved-plan provenance, criteria and typed requirements are structurally consistent with the subject Work Item.
The event evidence record is authoritative-looking, revision-pinned, and its subjectRef equals the subject Work Item.
The event review record matches the subject Work Item, event decision type and required schema fields.
The event authority decision matches the subject Work Item, event decision type and required schema fields.
Exactly one ACTIVE Acceptance Contract exists for the subject Work Item and its hash validates.
Every EVIDENCE requirement referenced by every criterion has a matching replay-ledger evidence record satisfying type, subject and integrity.
Every REVIEW requirement referenced by every criterion has a matching PASS review decision for the required capability.
Every satisfying review respects its configured independence policy.
Every AUTHORITY requirement referenced by every criterion has a matching APPROVED authority decision.
No recorded REJECTED authority decision exists for a required authority of the active contract.
Every criterion references at least one requirement and every referenced requirement is satisfied.
A review event satisfies its declared independence policy; performer and approving reviewer differ when required.
No evidence record with the same evidenceId is already present in the acceptance replay ledger.
No review decision with the same reviewId is already present in the acceptance replay ledger.
No authority decision with the same decisionId is already present in the acceptance replay ledger.
